description: Core foundation: the two additive nullable ServiceItem fields plus the two PURE Core helpers the editor and tests depend on, with full unit tests. This is the dependency base for FEAT-002/003 and leaves the solution buildable + all tests green with no WPF involved. Everything unit-testable lives in Core because WorshipPlayer.Tests cannot reference the WPF Presenter (see context.json). ServiceItemSettings is NOT changed — 'When complete' reuses its existing AutoAdvanceGoTo + GoToItemId.
steps: Add to ServiceItem in WorshipPlayer.Core\Models\ServiceOrder.cs: `[JsonPropertyName("audioAttachments")] public List<string>? AudioAttachments { get; set; }` and `[JsonPropertyName("stageTemplateId")] public string? StageTemplateId { get; set; }`. Both plain nullable (only [JsonPropertyName]) so the manager's WhenWritingNull omits them when null. Leave AudioAttachmentPath (non-nullable string) and ServiceItemSettings.cs untouched.

Create WorshipPlayer.Core\Services\ServiceItemAudio.cs: `public static class ServiceItemAudio { public static List<string> Resolve(ServiceItem item) }` returning `new(item.AudioAttachments)` when AudioAttachments is {Count:>0}, else a single-element list from a non-empty AudioAttachmentPath, else empty. Pure; never mutates the item. Copy the XML-doc intent from design.md Gap #2.

Create WorshipPlayer.Core\Services\SlideAutoAdvanceMap.cs: pure static load/save mapping for the two Auto-advance dropdowns onto existing ServiceItemSettings fields. SAVE: after-condition label -> AutoAdvanceAfterCondition via BulkEditService.ParseAfterCondition (so 'Disabled'/unknown -> Manual, 'Time Delay' -> Timer, 'End of Media' -> AudioEnd); when-complete label -> AutoAdvanceGoTo ('Do nothing'->NextSlide, 'Next item'->NextItem, 'Specific item'->SpecificItem, 'Loop'->Loop) and GoToItemId set only for SpecificItem. LOAD: AfterLabel copied from ItemSettingsMapping.AfterLabel (Timer->'Time Delay', AudioEnd->'End of Media', VideoEnd->'End of Media', Manual->'Disabled'); GoToLabel (NextSlide->'Do nothing', NextItem->'Next item', SpecificItem->'Specific item', Loop->'Loop'). Expose a predicate `WhenCompleteEnabled(string afterLabel)` = afterLabel != 'Disabled'. Keep labels in sentence case per the design ('Specific item', 'Next item').

Create WorshipPlayer.Tests\SlideServiceItemEditorModelTests.cs (xUnit, references WorshipPlayer.Core only — no linked Presenter source needed). Cover: (a) ServiceItemAudio.Resolve — legacy single path yields one-element list, populated AudioAttachments wins, both empty yields empty; (b) JSON round-trip with a JsonSerializerOptions matching the manager shape (WriteIndented + DefaultIgnoreCondition=WhenWritingNull + JsonStringEnumConverter): a ServiceItem with AudioAttachments + StageTemplateId + AutoAdvanceSettings{AutoAdvanceGoTo=SpecificItem,GoToItemId="x"} round-trips equal; with AudioAttachments=null and StageTemplateId=null the serialized string does NOT contain 'audioAttachments' or 'stageTemplateId'; (c) legacy-file load — deserialize a hand-written JSON blob that has 'audioAttachmentPath' set and none of the new keys, assert new fields null and ServiceItemAudio.Resolve yields the legacy path as the first entry; (d) SlideAutoAdvanceMap load/save table across the after axis (Disabled/Manual, Time Delay/Timer, End of Media/AudioEnd, and VideoEnd load-folds to 'End of Media' then re-saves as AudioEnd) x the when-complete axis (NextSlide/NextItem/SpecificItem+GoToItemId/Loop), including an explicit assertion of the VideoEnd->'End of Media'->AudioEnd normalization; (e) SQLite mirror — construct a ServiceOrderManager against a temp app.db + temp ServiceOrders folder (mirror TemplateServiceTests temp-db discipline, SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools() in Dispose), LoadAsync/set current/SaveAsync a ServiceOrder whose item carries the additive fields, then open the temp app.db with Microsoft.Data.Sqlite, SELECT DataJson from the ServiceOrders row, and assert it contains/round-trips the additive fields equal.
acceptance_criteria: ServiceItem exposes nullable AudioAttachments (List<string>?) and StageTemplateId (string?), both JSON-omitted when null.
ServiceItemSettings.cs is unchanged (no WhenComplete field/enum added).
ServiceItemAudio.Resolve and SlideAutoAdvanceMap are pure (no I/O, no mutation) and live in WorshipPlayer.Core.

`dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~SlideServiceItemEditorModelTests"` passes all new tests, including the WhenWritingNull omission assertion, the legacy-migration case, the VideoEnd normalization case, and the SQLite-mirror presence case.
verification: Run: dotnet build WorshipPlayer.UI/WorshipPlayer.UI.csproj -c Debug  (from the worktree root) — expect Build succeeded.
Run: dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~SlideServiceItemEditorModelTests"  — expect all new tests passed.
Run: dotnet test  — expect the full suite still green (no regressions).
findings:
DONE. Build + `dotnet test --filter SlideServiceItemEditorModelTests` (28 tests) + full suite (810 tests) all green.

MODEL (WorshipPlayer.Core.Models.ServiceItem, ServiceOrder.cs) — two additive plain-nullable props added after AudioAttachmentPath; omitted from JSON when null via the manager's WhenWritingNull:
  [JsonPropertyName("audioAttachments")] public List<string>? AudioAttachments { get; set; }
  [JsonPropertyName("stageTemplateId")] public string? StageTemplateId { get; set; }
Legacy AudioAttachmentPath (non-nullable string) and ServiceItemSettings.cs are UNCHANGED.

HELPERS (namespace WorshipPlayer.Core.Services, both pure/static, no I/O, no mutation):
  ServiceItemAudio.cs:
    public static List<string> Resolve(ServiceItem item)
      - AudioAttachments wins when {Count:>0}; else one-element list from non-empty legacy AudioAttachmentPath; else empty.
  SlideAutoAdvanceMap.cs — maps the two editor dropdowns onto existing ServiceItemSettings fields (no new storage). Public const string labels (sentence case) for FEAT-002 to bind ComboBoxes:
    AfterDisabled="Disabled", AfterTimeDelay="Time Delay", AfterEndOfMedia="End of Media"
    GoToDoNothing="Do nothing", GoToNextItem="Next item", GoToSpecificItem="Specific item", GoToLoop="Loop"
    public static void SaveAfter(ServiceItemSettings settings, string? afterLabel)   // delegates to BulkEditService.ParseAfterCondition -> Timer/AudioEnd/Manual
    public static void SaveWhenComplete(ServiceItemSettings settings, string? goToLabel, string? specificItemId)  // sets AutoAdvanceGoTo; GoToItemId only for SpecificItem else null
    public static string AfterLabel(ServiceItemSettings settings)   // Timer->Time Delay; AudioEnd+VideoEnd->End of Media; Manual->Disabled
    public static string GoToLabel(ServiceItemSettings settings)    // NextSlide->Do nothing, NextItem->Next item, SpecificItem->Specific item, Loop->Loop
    public static bool WhenCompleteEnabled(string afterLabel)       // afterLabel != "Disabled"
  Note: VideoEnd load-folds to "End of Media" and re-saves as AudioEnd (one-way normalization) — same as ItemSettingsMapping. SlideAutoAdvanceMap.SaveAfter/SaveWhenComplete mutate the PASSED settings object (editor owns lifecycle), unlike the pure ServiceItemAudio.Resolve.

TESTS: WorshipPlayer.Tests/SlideServiceItemEditorModelTests.cs (references Core only). SQLite-mirror test constructs ServiceOrderManager(serviceOrdersFolder, dbPath) with a temp app.db + temp ServiceOrders folder and SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools() in Dispose (TemplateServiceTests discipline); reads DataJson via Microsoft.Data.Sqlite. ManagerJsonOptions mirror = WriteIndented + DefaultIgnoreCondition=WhenWritingNull + JsonStringEnumConverter.

FEAT-002/003: persistence is automatic — ServiceOrderManager.SaveAsync already serializes with WhenWritingNull into both the JSON file and the app.db ServiceOrders.DataJson mirror; no manager/schema change needed for the additive fields.
